room-3d: Hey — welcome to Chess Arena. This is the three-D room. Just watch it spin for a second. The pieces are actually playing. This is a live game, not a screenshot.
camera: You can look around yourself, too. Drag to orbit. Hit Fixed if you want a locked angle. On a phone, tap Cam and these controls pop up.
board-2d: If the three-D room isn't your thing, there's a flat two-D board. Same game, same moves. We're flipping back to three-D in a second — this is just so you know it's here.
view-toggle: This switch up here is how you flip between two-D and three-D whenever you want. Themes live here too. For the rest of the tour, we're staying in the three-D room.
mobile-bar: This bar is for phones. Whose turn it is, step through moves, and Menu opens the full game panel.
sidebar-game: Here's the game panel. Room code, what mode you're in, whose turn it is. On a phone this slides up from Menu.
sidebar-history: This is time travel. Step back and forward through the game. You're only looking — it doesn't change the live position.
sidebar-coach: Coach shows up in bot and local games. Ask for a hint, check the last move, or scan for threats if you're getting squeezed.
sidebar-invite: If you're playing online, this is where the invite lives. Share the link and they sit as Black on their own device.
sidebar-actions: Draws and resign live here. Offer a draw, claim one, or resign — or just wait for them to answer.
sidebar-moves: Every move lands in this list, in normal chess notation, so you can recap the game without scrubbing the board.
sidebar-leave: Whenever you're done, leave the room from here. Next game starts back in the lobby.
brand: And this is the lobby. Home base — online rooms, bots, hot-seat. Two-D or the three-D room, your call.
theme: Themes live here. I'll flip through them so you can see the different rooms. Tap a circle anytime — whatever you pick is saved.
nav: Sign in if you want a profile, friends, challenges, leaderboard. If you'd rather just play, guests can do that too.
play: Four ways in. Bot as White or Black, an online room, or hot-seat on one device.
play-bot: Play versus Bot — that's practice against the engine as White. Tap the card and you're in a room.
play-bot-black: Or take Black and let the engine move first. Really good if you want to learn how to defend.
play-online: Online room: you create it, copy the invite, and play live over the web.
play-local: Hot seat is two people, one screen. Pass the device between White and Black.
bot-level: Before you hit Play versus Bot, pick the strength — beginner all the way up to master.
join: Already have a code or a link? Paste it here and you sit as the second player.
server: This is the live chess server. Sometimes it's waking up. If it looks asleep, wait a second and retry.
lobby-hero: That's the pitch: three-D pieces, live multiplayer, bots you can turn up or down, and a coach in the room.
lobby-features: You also get legal-move hints, drag and drop, ratings, friends — it's all in one arena.
done: You're in. Spin the room, drag a piece to move, and on a phone use Menu. Want this tour again later? It's under Tutorial. Have fun.
